title: 1.2 Food and Nutrition Security
description: Food availability, nutrition, crop production and the fight against hunger. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? A situation where all people have access to sufficient safe food
Which term matches this description? A lack of reliable access to enough affordable nutritious food
Which term matches this description? A condition caused by an unbalanced or inadequate diet
Which term matches this description? A condition of insufficient intake of energy or nutrients
Which term matches this description? A shortage of vitamins or minerals needed for health
Which term matches this description? A crop that supplies a major share of people daily calories
Which term matches this description? Growing several crop species rather than a single crop
Which term matches this description? Processing food to slow spoilage and extend its shelf life
Which term matches this description? The controlled supply of water to crops in dry periods
Which term matches this description? The ability of soil to supply nutrients needed by crops
Which term matches this description? A material added to soil to supply essential plant nutrients
Which term matches this description? Measures used to reduce losses caused by insect and disease pests
Which term matches this description? Food lost between the field and the final consumer
Which term matches this description? Food supplied to communities facing acute shortages
Which term matches this description? The ability of a community to produce most of its own food
Which term matches this description? Consuming a wide range of foods across food groups
Which term matches this description? Practices that keep food free from harmful contaminants
Which term matches this description? Adding nutrients to food to improve its nutritional value
Which term matches this description? A service that teaches farmers improved farming methods
Which term matches this description? The sequence of steps that moves food from farm to plate
